rivals.name: retained_exact_body_median_extension
rivals.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((a (at g 0 0))
                  (b (at g 0 1))
                  (c (at g 2 2))
                  (colors (list a (- (+ a b c) (min a (min b c)) (max a (max b c))) c))
                  (pat (list (list 0 1 1 1 0 0 2 1 0 2)
                             (list 1 1 2 1 1 0 2 1 0 2)
                             (list 1 2 2 2 1 0 2 1 0 2)
                             (list 1 1 2 1 1 0 2 1 0 2)
                             (list 0 1 1 1 0 0 2 1 0 2)
                             (list 0 0 0 0 0 2 2 1 0 2)
                             (list 2 2 2 2 2 2 1 1 0 2)
                             (list 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 0 0 2)
                             (list 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 2 2)
                             (list 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 1))))
             (build-grid 10 10 (r col) (if (and (< r 5) (< col 5)) (at g r col) (list-ref colors (at pat r col))))))))

rivals.name: cue_grammar_median_extension_same_downstream_stages
rivals.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((a (at g 0 0))
         (b (at g 0 1))
         (c (at g 2 2))
         (colors (list a (- (+ a b c) (min a (min b c)) (max a (max b c))) c))
                  (true-colors (list a b c))
         (pat (list (list 0 1 1 1 0 0 2 1 0 2)
                    (list 1 1 2 1 1 0 2 1 0 2)
                    (list 1 2 2 2 1 0 2 1 0 2)
                    (list 1 1 2 1 1 0 2 1 0 2)
                    (list 0 1 1 1 0 0 2 1 0 2)
                    (list 0 0 0 0 0 2 2 1 0 2)
                    (list 2 2 2 2 2 2 1 1 0 2)
                    (list 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 0 0 2)
                    (list 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 2 2)
                    (list 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 1)))
         (base (build-grid 10 10 (r col) (list-ref (if (and (< r 5) (< col 5)) true-colors colors) (at pat r col))))
         (cue (first (find-color g 0)))
         (turns (cond ((= (first cue) 0) 0)
                      ((= (second cue) 4) 1)
                      ((= (first cue) 4) 2)
                      (else 3)))
         (intermediate
          (build-grid 10 10 (r col)
            (cond ((= turns 0) (at base r col))
                  ((= turns 1) (at base (- 9 col) r))
                  ((= turns 2) (at base (- 9 r) (- 9 col)))
                  (else (at base col (- 9 r))))))
         (target
          (first
           (filter
            (lambda (obj) (member? (list 0 1) (obj-cells obj)))
            (objects intermediate 0)))))
    (paint-cells intermediate (obj-cells target) 0))))
